# Card 367: partial research candidate

Status: **partial research candidate**. Not a solved-card claim.

[Catalogue record](https://crypto.hcportal.eu/dashboard/cryptograms/1686) · [original picture source](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5118/pc_hcp_367_pic.JPG) · [candidate JSON](367.json)

Picture source SHA256: `ab6116c16bae818a55d88f057bbc9ea1570cc704d5ea56e99d038665eb2a8483`. Original dimensions 1785 × 1175.

Each of the two related, key-visible source actors froze that actor’s own raw layer for this card before that actor’s subsequent decoder call. This does not assert that both actors had frozen before either actor decoded. This edition is explicitly **nonblind curation**: both frozen readings and the scans were available. No human/external verification or blind independence is claimed. The unchanged repository decoder mechanically produced each selected literal below.

Every `?` below is an **editorial unknown glyph/cluster**, not an asserted written question mark. It can conceal an unknown number of physical bodies. Written punctuation-like marks are separately tagged in JSON. q/g is a graphical ambiguity (canonical q = K, g = Z); fluent Czech has not selected between them. Marked bodies, m/n and other reader disputes also remain masked. Physical encoded-body count: **undetermined**.

The JSON includes both complete original raw objects and hashes, complete original source ledgers, projected selected offsets, all row disagreements, broad native/reading rectangles, source acquisition/inspection records and literal decoder statistics. This Markdown is a readable fragment edition, not a replacement for that complete ledger.

Both whole faces and all margins were inspected. No additional continuous encoded address run was detected within the visible frame; faint/erased material is not ruled out. Ordinary addresses and names remain untranscribed. Actor B’s frozen provenance contains unverified ordinary date-like literal fields; those fields are retained unchanged in JSON but excluded from selected ciphertext, proposals and historical conclusions.

CZ/EN entries propose only the quoted row-local fragments. Brackets show speculative restorations or spelling repairs. Unlisted portions remain literal, unreconstructed fragments; no smooth sentences bridge masked clauses. Names, locations and calendar tokens are not authenticated.

## Main inscription

### 367-P-L01

Selected literal: `VRELY DI?, SRDEC?O MOJE JEDINE, ?A DRAHY LISTE? V?C?REJS?. OBSAHEM JEHO JSEM SE VSA?`

CZ, qualified fragments: [Srdečko?] moje jediné; … drahý [lístek?] [včerejší?] … [zbytek: doslovné fragmenty, neobnoveno]

EN, qualified fragments: my only [sweetheart?]; … dear [note?] from [yesterday?] … [remainder: literal fragments, not reconstructed]

- Evidence `SRDEC?O MOJE JEDINE`: The marked/looped middle body remains masked; srdečko is a lexical proposal, not a repaired cipher selection.
- Evidence `DRAHY LISTE? V?C?REJS?`: Lístek/včerejší require masked bodies, and the second word also has reader disputes; both completions are bracketed.

Unreconstructed literal material: `VRELY DI?, `; `, ?A `; `. OBSAHEM JEHO JSEM SE VSA?`.

### 367-P-L02

Selected literal: `?ARMOUT?L. VIDIM, ?E SI ANIC?A ?Y??? ?BYTECNE ?TRPC?JE ?IVOT. PO ?ELY LETOSNI`

CZ, qualified fragments: vidím; … po [celý?] letošní … … [zbytek: doslovné fragmenty, neobnoveno]

EN, qualified fragments: I see; … throughout this [whole?] … … [remainder: literal fragments, not reconstructed]

proposed_czech: Vřelý dík, srdéčko moje jediné, za drahý lístek včerejší. Obsahem jeho jsem se však zarmoutil. Vidím, že si Anička [zcela?] zbytečně [ztrpčuje?] život. Po celý letošní rok pronáší Anička pochybnosti o mé lásce, ačkoli já jsem zůstal týmž, jako jsem byl dříve. Mám Tě naopak ještě více rád. Patrně datují se tyto [pochybnosti?] od Tvé cesty se slečnou [Sládkovou?], která Ti řekla, že prý mne chtěli oženiti s mojí sestřenicí [Koškovou?]. Opakuji Ti, Aničko, ještě jednou, že se tak nikdy nestane a že jsem nyní naprosto na ženění [nepomyslil?]. Také o žádnou jinou dámu se nezajímám. Žiji, Aničko, jen Tobě, kterou mám tak rád, jako jsem neměl dosud nikoho jiného. Jsem výhradně [jen Tvůj?]. Těšil jsem se nesmírně, že budu se moci o Božím Těle opět s Tebou se setkati. Nemohu však žádati na svém srdéčku něco, co by mu způsobilo opět nepříjemnosti. Naprosto však se snad nemusíme zříci naděje, že se budeme moci setkati. Ovšem [bude?] si museti Anička sama ustanoviti schůzku takovou, kde by byla bezpečna [před?] [nepříjemností?]. Poslední místo naší schůzky nezdálo se mi vůbec [vhodným?], poněvadž je tam Anička moc známá. Na Tebe zajisté nikdy nezapomenu, i kdybychom se snad měli ještě řidčeji vídati [než?] dosud. Vím, že také moje vřele milované srdéčko nezapomene. Tvoji předrahou, líbeznou [hlavinku?] v duchu vřele a nesčíslněkráte [líbá?], Tvůj a jen Tvůj [Berouš?], který prosí o brzký lístek. Kdo [pověděl?] milostivé paní o naší [schůzce?]? Kterého dne dala jsi poslední lístek na poštu?
proposed_english: Warm thanks, my only sweetheart, for yesterday’s dear note. Its contents, however, made me sad. I see that Anička is making her life [completely?] and needlessly [bitter?]. Throughout this whole year Anička has voiced doubts about my love, although I have remained the same as I was before. On the contrary, I love you even more. These [doubts?] apparently date from your journey with Miss [Sládková?], who told you that they supposedly wanted to marry me off to my cousin [Košková?]. I repeat once again, Anička, that this will never happen and that I have now [given no thought?] at all to marriage. Nor am I interested in any other lady. I live only for you, Anička, whom I love as I have never loved anyone else before. I am exclusively [only yours?]. I had looked forward immensely to being able, at Corpus Christi, to meet you again. I cannot however ask my sweetheart for something that would cause trouble again. Yet perhaps we need not completely abandon hope that we will be able to meet. Of course Anička [will?] have to arrange such a meeting herself, where she would be safe [from?] [trouble?]. The last place of our meeting did not seem at all [suitable?] to me, because there Anička is very well known. I will certainly never forget you, even if we should see each other even less often [than?] before. I know that my dearly beloved sweetheart too will not forget. Your most precious, lovely [little head?] is warmly [kissed?] in spirit countless times by your and only your [Berouš?], who asks for a note soon. Who [told?] the gracious lady about our [meeting?]? On which day did you put the last note in the post?
